title: Stroke Copilot vision output
description: The only object the vision side hands to the NLP side (plan §6). v0.1, draft until Phase 0 closes. Volumes are in mL rounded to one decimal; null means not computed and must be read as unknown, never as zero. Rounding and derived-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by strokecopilot.contract.schema.VisionOutput.

model_version.description: Git tag or commit of the vision models that produced this object.

haemorrhage.description: Vision B output on plain CT.

present.description: Any intracranial haemorrhage on plain CT.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability that intracranial haemorrhage is present.

core_ml.description: Infarct core volume, mL, one decimal. null if not computed.

penumbra_ml.description: Total hypoperfused volume (Tmax > 6 s), mL, one decimal. Includes the core; salvageable tissue is mismatch_volume_ml. null if not computed.

mismatch_ratio.description: penumbra_ml / core_ml, two decimals. null if core_ml < 1 mL or either volume is null.

mismatch_volume_ml.description: penumbra_ml - core_ml, mL, one decimal. null if either volume is null.

occlusion_site.description: Vessel occlusion site from the CTA occlusion mask.

aspects.description: ASPECTS score on NCCT, 0-10. No model produces this: null from the real pipeline, set only in fixtures and synthetic scenarios. null means unknown, never a low score.

warnings.description: Pipeline warnings, e.g. "motion artefact", "incomplete perfusion coverage".
